text: v0.5 P10 (bl-a144): lernie stop <repo> <branch> — cascading SIGTERM (ARCH §2.9). Pid via /proc/<pid>/fd/* writer scan against latest response.json (no sidecar pid file — same source the §3.5 in_flight classification reads). lernie prompt setpgid(0,0)s itself so the kernel cascade reaches its provider adapter and any subagent harnesses re-entered via lernie dispatch. Idempotent for already-stopped branches; errors for missing or already-merged ones. Linux-only.
